literature_notes: The ledger contains only two lines (L1, L2), both describing the same CD4-GPA chimeric fusion construct from PMC13519646. That construct fuses the CD4 signal peptide and D1D2 extracellular domains (~180 aa) to the N-terminus of full-length GPA, with a nine-amino-acid linker, to display CD4 on erythrocyte surfaces as a viral decoy receptor. It is disqualified on two independent grounds: (1) the rules explicitly exclude 'decoy-receptor reagent' constructs, and L2 describes the purpose as 'present CD4 on the erythrocyte surface as a viral decoy receptor'; (2) CD4 D1D2 is a large folded protein domain, not a short epitope tag (13–23 aa) of the kind the task targets. No other ledger lines exist for GYPA. Zero sites qualify.
